text: Duracell became a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway Inc. in February 2016: per P&G's own SEC filing, 'Procter & Gamble (NYSE:PG) has announced the completion of the transfer of its Duracell business to Berkshire Hathaway,' with P&G contributing cash to Duracell in exchange for Berkshire Hathaway's 52 million shares of P&G stock.

source.name: Procter & Gamble press release (filed on SEC EDGAR): P&G Completes Exchange of Duracell to Berkshire Hathaway
source.quote: Procter & Gamble (NYSE:PG) has announced the completion of the transfer of its Duracell business to Berkshire Hathaway.
